slide1.heroTitle:
Your body's score
prevents injury and
makes you stronger.
slide1.heroSub:
AI combines sleep, fatigue, and training load
to guide your best practice today

slide2.title: What sCORE can do
slide2.subtitle:
It's not just about logging.
Your accumulated data changes tomorrow's practice.

features.title: Track your body's score in real time
features.desc: Combines sleep, fatigue, and training load into one number, so you know instantly whether to push today.

features.title: AI designs today's menu
features.desc: Just pick from your practice library. AI builds a pro-coach-level menu for you.

features.title: Detect injury risk early
features.desc: Detects fatigue, poor sleep, and declining condition, and alerts you before an injury happens.

features.title: Work backward from your goal
features.desc: Set your competition date and target time. AI builds a training plan working backward from there.

slide3.title: Does this sound familiar?
slide3.subtitle: Select anything that applies to you
checklist: I've missed an important race due to injury
I train hard but my times aren't improving
I can't quantify my own physical condition
I can't keep up a training journal
I never know if I've actually recovered from fatigue
Planning a practice menu from scratch every time is a hassle
slide3.resultSub: sCORE was built to solve all of these.

slide4.title: Better tracking changes your results
slide4.subtitle: Given equal effort, the athlete who tracks wins.
before: Only learn the cause of an injury after the fact
Planning a menu from scratch every time
Relying on gut feeling for your condition
after: See your condition at a glance with a score
Detect injury risk before it happens
AI builds a menu in 30 seconds
Your data becomes a weapon for the next practice

slide5.title: A message from the developer
slide5.message:
Throughout my years in track and field, I've been sidelined by injury more times than I can count.

Every time, I had to guess whether my fatigue had cleared or whether it was safe to push hard that day. And more than once, pushing too hard is exactly what sidelined me again.

If only I could have actually seen my body's condition as a number back then. If only I could have noticed the warning signs before the injury happened.

That regret is why sCORE exists.

I want even one fewer athlete to go through what I did. I want even one more athlete to be able to train at full effort.

I believe that staying on the starting line, season after season, is the strongest strategy there is.
